description: Fetch all designated-area rows for a specific FEMA disaster by disaster number (e.g., 4781). Returns every county/municipality designated under the declaration along with programs activated, incident period, and state info. Use fema_search_disasters to find disaster numbers. The returned disaster_number chains to fema_get_public_assistance and fema_get_housing_assistance.

disaster_number.description: FEMA disaster number (e.g., 4781). Obtain from fema_search_disasters.

name: fema_get_disaster

declaration_date.description: ISO 8601 date the declaration was signed.

declaration_type.description: Declaration type: DR (major disaster), EM (emergency), or FM (fire management).

designated_area_count.description: Total number of designated areas in this declaration.

designated_areas.description: All counties/municipalities designated for assistance under this declaration.

area.description: Name of the designated county or municipality.

fips_county_code.description: 3-digit county FIPS code. Absent when not returned.

fips_state_code.description: 2-digit state FIPS code. Absent when not returned.

disaster_number.description: FEMA disaster number — use as the chain key for PA and housing assistance tools.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: No declaration found with the given disaster number. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

hm_declared.description: True when Hazard Mitigation grants were declared.

ia_declared.description: True when the Individuals and Households Program (IHP) was declared — indicates IA housing/personal grants are available.

incident_begin_date.description: ISO 8601 start date of the incident. Absent when not recorded.

incident_end_date.description: ISO 8601 end date of the incident. Absent for ongoing or unrecorded incidents.

incident_type.description: Type of incident (e.g., Flood, Hurricane, Severe Storm).

pa_declared.description: True when Public Assistance (infrastructure recovery grants) was declared.

title.description: Official declaration title (e.g., "SEVERE STORMS AND FLOODING").

title: Get FEMA Disaster Details
